tracks.title: Let It Be
tracks.description: The familiar chorus on piano, supported by the Am–G–F–C descent and soft sustained glass.

tracks.title: Stand by Me
tracks.description: The walking bass hook takes the lead, with warm upper chords and restrained hand percussion.

tracks.title: Billie Jean
tracks.description: The low F-sharp bass ostinato stays out in front; short minor-chord answers and tight drums surround it.

tracks.title: Take On Me
tracks.description: The quick keyboard hook becomes a clean marimba line, with B-minor, E, A, and D underneath.

tracks.title: Lean on Me
tracks.description: A direct, singable piano staircase, with gospel-like chord answers and a low plucked pulse.

tracks.title: Imagine
tracks.description: The opening vocal phrase on piano, with the quiet C-to-F motion and a soft glass halo.

tracks.title: Seven Nation Army
tracks.description: The seven-note guitar riff anchors the planet, with a grounded beat and dark, sparse chord replies.

tracks.title: Another One Bites the Dust
tracks.description: The bass riff keeps its stops and short notes; dry kalimba chords and a clipped backbeat leave it room.

tracks.title: Sweet Child O’ Mine
tracks.description: The wide, octave-jumping guitar introduction spans the sphere, with the original lowered tuning and clear bass changes.

tracks.title: Clocks
tracks.description: The descending piano figure follows E-flat into B-flat minor, with broad low roots and quiet upper chord tones.

tracks.title: Nothing Else Matters
tracks.description: The open-string E-minor arpeggio rolls in six, with long piano roots and very light glass answers.

tracks.title: (I Can’t Get No) Satisfaction
tracks.description: The insistent B–C-sharp–D guitar hook against an E dominant vamp, with clipped chord stabs and a firm beat.

tracks.title: Prelude in C Major
tracks.description: The first two rolling figures from BWV 846, with a held C foundation and chord tones that follow the arpeggio.

tracks.title: Minuet in G
tracks.description: The familiar opening from the Anna Magdalena notebook, with a lilting three-beat accompaniment.

tracks.title: Eine kleine Nachtmusik
tracks.description: The punchy opening fanfare, with short articulations, alternating bass, and answering plucked chords.

tracks.title: Moonlight Sonata
tracks.description: The opening C-sharp-minor triplet figure over its descending bass, with sustained glass and almost whispered percussion.

tracks.title: Swan Lake
tracks.description: The sweeping minor-key swan theme on glass, with a broad bass and gently moving guitar harmony.

tracks.title: Fly Me to the Moon
tracks.description: The descending jazz-standard melody, with seventh-chord voicings, soft guitar bass, and offbeat comping.

tracks.title: Autumn Leaves
tracks.description: The falling sequence moves through D minor, G, C, and F, with low piano and warm glass sevenths.

tracks.title: In the Mood
tracks.description: The famous rising and falling riff gets a 3:1 swing pulse, a walking foundation, and short guitar chords.
